text_block_list.text: One morning, in the dorm lobby...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hmm hum hum~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing! Did your moonwalk get even 
better?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Really!? I gotta go show everyone else!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. After you get ready for school, 
okay? Come on, breakfast first.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Nature! Look!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Still as skilled as ever, I see. Wait, 
did you get faster than before?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ahem! I can even do this!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, so good. Still, let's make sure we 
aren't late.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Look, look, McQueen! Moonwalk!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my. You seem to have gained even more 
sharpness. However—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Turbo, class is currently in session, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Small Child
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Your mama will be right back, okay? So 
stop crying—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaaa!! All eyes on Turbo~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gliding, sliding along~♪

text_block_list.name: Small Child
text_block_list.text:
...Waaaah~! Amazing~! I wanna do it too! 
How do you do it~?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Making a crying kid smile like that— 
you're pretty good, aren't ya!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ahem! Turbo is amazing, right~!

Perhaps due to doing so many moonwalks, 
her muscles were strengthened... and from 
that day on, her running became much 
sharper!
